mapper.select: WITH current_step AS ( SELECT CAST(#{apprId} AS numeric) AS appr_id , CAST(#{stepTypeCode} AS varchar) AS step_type_cd , CAST(#{seq} AS int) AS seq ), agree_start AS ( SELECT MIN(a.apr04_seq::int) AS start_seq FROM apr04_appr_step a INNER JOIN current_step c ON a.apr04_appr_id = c.appr_id WHERE a.apr04_step_type_cd = '20' AND a.apr04_seq::int <= c.seq::int AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM apr04_appr_step x WHERE x.apr04_appr_id = a.apr04_appr_id AND x.apr04_step_type_cd != '20' AND x.apr04_seq::int < c.seq::int AND x.apr04_seq::int >= a.apr04_seq::int ) ), prev_seq AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN c.step_type_cd = '10' THEN ( SELECT MAX(a.apr04_seq::int) FROM apr04_appr_step a WHERE a.apr04_appr_id = c.appr_id AND a.apr04_step_type_cd != '30' AND a.apr04_seq::int < c.seq ) WHEN c.step_type_cd = '20' THEN ( SELECT MAX(a.apr04_seq::int) FROM apr04_appr_step a CROSS JOIN agree_start g WHERE a.apr04_appr_id = c.appr_id AND a.apr04_step_type_cd != '30' AND a.apr04_seq::int < g.start_seq ) END AS prev_seq FROM current_step c ) SELECT CASE WHEN p.prev_seq IS NULL THEN 'Y' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM apr04_appr_step a INNER JOIN current_step c ON a.apr04_appr_id = c.appr_id WHERE a.apr04_seq::int = p.prev_seq AND a.apr04_appr_date IS NOT NULL ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS can_approve FROM prev_seq p

WITH current_step AS ( SELECT CAST(#{apprId} AS numeric) AS appr_id , CAST(#{stepTypeCode} AS varchar) AS step_type_cd , CAST(#{seq} AS int) AS seq ), agree_end AS ( SELECT MAX(a.apr04_seq::int) AS end_seq FROM apr04_appr_step a WHERE a.apr04_appr_id = #{apprId} AND a.apr04_step_type_cd = '20' AND a.apr04_seq::int >= CAST(#{seq} AS int) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM apr04_appr_step x WHERE x.apr04_appr_id = a.apr04_appr_id AND x.apr04_step_type_cd = '10' AND x.apr04_seq::int > CAST(#{seq} AS int) AND x.apr04_seq::int < a.apr04_seq::int ) ), next_seq AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN c.step_type_cd = '10' THEN ( SELECT MIN(a.apr04_seq::int) FROM apr04_appr_step a WHERE a.apr04_appr_id = c.appr_id AND a.apr04_step_type_cd != '30' AND a.apr04_seq::int > c.seq ) WHEN c.step_type_cd = '20' THEN ( SELECT MIN(a.apr04_seq::int) FROM apr04_appr_step a CROSS JOIN agree_end g WHERE a.apr04_appr_id = c.appr_id AND a.apr04_step_type_cd != '30' AND a.apr04_seq::int > g.end_seq ) END AS next_seq FROM current_step c ) SELECT CASE WHEN n.next_seq IS NULL THEN 'Y' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM apr04_appr_step a INNER JOIN current_step c ON a.apr04_appr_id = c.appr_id WHERE a.apr04_seq::int = n.next_seq AND a.apr04_appr_date IS NULL ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS can_next_approve FROM next_seq n
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_appr_id = #{apprId} AND COALESCE(apr04_step_status_cd, 'none') IN ('20', '30')

SELECT apr04_step_type_cd AS step_type_code , apr04_seq AS seq , ( CASE WHEN apr04_step_type_cd = '40' THEN ( CASE WHEN COALESCE(apr07_stamp_yn, 'false') = 'true' THEN ( SELECT COALESCE(apr10_second_emp_id, apr10_emp_id) FROM apr10_stamp WHERE apr10_stamp_id = apr01_stamp_id ) ELSE apr04_step_emp_id END ) WHEN apr04_step_type_cd != '30' THEN COALESCE(apr07_alt_emp_id, apr04_step_emp_id) ELSE apr04_step_emp_id END ) AS step_emp_id FROM apr04_appr_step INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = apr04_appr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr07_alt_appr ON apr07_target_emp_id = apr04_step_emp_id AND f_sysdate()::date BETWEEN apr07_start_date AND apr07_close_date WHERE apr04_appr_id = #{apprId} AND apr04_seq::integer > CAST(#{seq} AS INTEGER) AND apr04_step_type_cd NOT IN ('00', '30') ORDER BY apr04_seq

SELECT apr04_step_type_cd AS step_type_code , apr04_step_status_cd AS step_status_code FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_appr_id = #{apprId} ORDER BY f_to_number(apr04_seq), apr04_step_type_cd, apr04_appr_step_id

WITH sys AS ( SELECT COALESCE(sys01_dcr_numbering_cd, '1') AS dcr_numbering_cd , CASE WHEN COALESCE(sys01_dcr_numbering_cd, '1') = '2' THEN COALESCE(org02_dcr_id_word, '') ELSE '' END AS dcr_id_word FROM sys01_company INNER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM org01_code INNER JOIN org02_info ON org02_code_id = org01_code_id WHERE org01_company_id = #{companyId} AND org01_code_id = CAST(f_get_emptrans(#{regEmpId}, CAST(#{regDate} AS date), 'org_code_id') AS NUMERIC) AND org02_mod_date = ( SELECT MAX(org02_mod_date) FROM org02_info WHERE org02_code_id = org01_code_id AND org02_mod_date <= #{regDate} ) ) sys ON org01_company_id = sys01_company_id ) SELECT (SELECT dcr_id_word FROM sys) || stamp_seq AS apr01_stamp_seq FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(MAX(REPLACE(t.apr01_stamp_seq, COALESCE(apr01_dcr_id_word, dcr_id_word), '')::numeric), 0) + 1 AS stamp_seq FROM ( SELECT apr01_stamp_seq AS apr01_stamp_seq , COALESCE(apr01_dcr_id_word, '') AS apr01_dcr_id_word FROM apr01_appr WHERE to_char(apr01_reg_date, 'yyyy') = to_char(f_today(), 'yyyy') AND apr01_company_id = #{companyId} UNION ALL SELECT apr99_stamp_seq AS apr01_stamp_seq , COALESCE(apr99_dcr_id_word, '') AS apr01_dcr_id_word FROM apr99_appr_del WHERE to_char(apr99_reg_date, 'yyyy') = to_char(f_today(), 'yyyy') AND apr99_company_id = #{companyId} ) t , sys WHERE ( ( dcr_numbering_cd = '2' AND apr01_dcr_id_word = dcr_id_word ) OR ( dcr_numbering_cd = '1' AND apr01_dcr_id_word = '' ) ) ) A WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = #{apprId} AND sys10_title_yn = 'true' )

SELECT CASE WHEN apr11_advert_seq <= 9999 THEN 10000 ELSE apr11_advert_seq END AS apr11_advert_seq FROM ( SELECT (COALESCE(MAX(CAST(apr11_advert_seq AS numeric)), 10000)) + 1 AS apr11_advert_seq FROM apr11_advert_book ) t
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO apr11_advert_book ( apr11_advert_book_id, apr11_advert_seq, apr11_advert_type_nm, apr11_media_nm, apr11_cnt, apr11_note, apr11_appr_id, apr11_company_id ) SELECT f_create_seq(), CAST(#{advertSeq} AS varchar), NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, #{apprId}, #{companyId}
mapper.update: UPDATE apr04_appr_step SET apr04_step_status_cd = '10' , apr04_appr_date = NULL , apr04_note = NULL , apr04_reject_reason = NULL , apr04_appr_emp_id = NULL WHERE apr04_appr_step_id = #{apprStepId}
UPDATE apr01_appr SET apr01_status_cd = '99' WHERE apr01_appr_id = #{apprId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM apr16_stamp_doc WHERE apr16_appr_id = #{apprId} AND ( ( apr16_appl_type IN ('1','2') AND apr16_reg_date IS NOT NULL ) OR ( apr16_appl_type IN ('3') AND apr16_stamp_date IS NOT NULL ) )

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO apr99_appr_del SELECT f_create_seq() , apr01_appr_id , apr01_title , apr01_reg_date , apr01_status_cd , apr01_content , apr01_note , apr01_reg_emp_id , apr01_effect_date , apr01_class_tree_id , apr01_stamp_id , apr01_receive_nm , apr01_reference_nm , apr01_stamp_seq , apr01_inout_cd , f_sysdate() , #{empId} , apr01_company_id , apr01_form_type , apr01_dcr_id_word , apr01_sign_company , apr01_sign_ceo , apr01_stamp_position , apr01_link_cd FROM apr01_appr WHERE apr01_appr_id = #{apprId}
